label: kizuna_language_c_02
text: Thanks to your advice from before, Pawmi is...\nWell, just see for yourself![VAR 0x0114(0026)]

label: kizuna_language_c_03
text: Hmm...yeah. It’s feeling better, but this particular\nPawmi may just be a bit meek, I suppose?[VAR 0x0114(0026)]

label: kizuna_language_c_ecology_01
text: I had Nurse Miriam take a look as well, and she\nsays there’s nothing wrong with it healthwise![VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: kizuna_language_c_ecology_02
text: So it shouldn’t have any injuries, ailments, or\nthe like.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: kizuna_language_c_04
text: Even so, it never utters so much as a cry, which\nis odd.[VAR 0x0114(0026)]

label: kizuna_language_c_05
text: That part has even Mr. Jacq here stumped.[VAR 0x0114(0026)]

label: kizuna_language_c_ecology_03
text: Sorry that I couldn’t be of any help...[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: kizuna_language_c_06
text: Ne t’inquiète pas! Don’t worry about it![VAR 0x0114(0026)]

label: kizuna_language_c_07
text: I have some more information now thanks to the\nacademy’s security cameras, though.[VAR 0x0114(0026)]

label: kizuna_language_c_08
text: It seems Pawmi was attacked by a wild Pokémon\nand fled here to the academy grounds.[VAR 0x0114(0026)]

label: kizuna_language_c_09
text: Maybe it’s still in a bit of shock from that\nexperience and can’t bring itself to speak yet?[VAR 0x0114(0026)]

label: kizuna_language_c_10
text: Yep! If that’s the case, there’s absolutely no\nproblem with keeping quiet! Pas de problème![VAR 0x0114(0026)]

label: kizuna_language_c_11
text: We can just attendre—wait, that is—until it feels\nlike talking! That’s all we can do, really![VAR 0x0114(0026)]

label: kizuna_language_c_12
text: Even if you can speak all sorts of languages,\nthere’s no guarantee that you can understand\r\nwhat’s going on in someone’s heart.[VAR 0x0114(0026)]

label: kizuna_language_c_13
text: But have no fear! I won’t give up! No—I’ll keep\non trying until we’ve figured each other out![VAR 0x0114(0026)]

label: kizuna_language_c_system_01
text: You feel trusted by Mr. Salvatore!
